I replied to Pree in a thread on their #central-team message. I couldn't confirm the 23 May deadline for Thornbury Cloth Co.'s signed order form. There's nothing on Thornbury or an order form deadline in #central-team, the shared account files or the workspace brain. The brain was searching by keyword only, so it could have missed something worded differently.

I also pointed out that 23 May has already passed this year (it's October 2026). They might have meant 2027, or it might have been misheard. I suggested Pree check with the Thornbury contact or with June Osei-Lark on the deal desk before anyone plans around the date.

I didn't save the claim to the brain as a fact, since it's unverified.
